name: Mustard greens

schedule.notes: Succession every 2 to 3 weeks while weather is cool.
Fall crop is milder; flavor sweetens after a light frost.
Cut outer leaves at 4 in for cooking; baby leaves at 2 in for salad.

harvest.cues: Leaves 4 to 8 in, vibrant green or red. Cut outer leaves at the base.
harvest.storageNotes: Fridge in damp paper towel 5 to 7 days. Excellent fermented.

varieties.name: Florida Broadleaf
varieties.notes: Mild compared to others. Cooks down well.

varieties.name: Red Giant
varieties.notes: Purple-red leaves, hot and pungent. Beautiful in mixed salads.

varieties.name: Mizuna
varieties.notes: Feathery green leaves, mild peppery flavor. Slow to bolt.

notes: Bolts hot in summer — plant in spring and fall, skip June through August. Heat increases pungency; cool weather = milder, sweeter leaves.
